abilities.name: Cultivate plants
abilities.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; tend plots; abandon unfinished planting.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; x, y a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, with fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Two paid rounds of 1 energy: dig, then place and cover the unit; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Tend: target a planted plot in reach; one round, 0.5 energy. Abandon: stops unfinished planting; one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
abilities.effects: Digging keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the plot, where it cannot be eaten or used; the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one. It establishes only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 20 rounds, optional checks at 5, 10 and 20; not a growth date. Tend checks the plot and its 0.6 m clearance, kept free of plants by the plant rules; it removes nothing and adds no water, nutrient or growth. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Abandon, or death, before placement returns the unit once (where the person died); a placed unit stays. No reward or refund.

reviews.reason: Develop a general operation for heat-preparing owned food, including a minimal, physically gated fire-starting and tending mode. The related-capability search found gather, eat, probe and plant-cultivation, but no equivalent heat source, ignition or cooking function. Gather transfers accessible materials, probe supports limited observations or sample tests, and eat consumes food; none supplies the requested transformation. Reuse those implementations rather than representing them as new inventions. Missing heat and equipment mechanisms belong in the current-conversation development handoff, not a permanent rejection. Visible branches do not establish ownership, dryness, suitable ignition materials or an existing fire. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No happiness, pleasure, satisfaction or mastery award is attached to requesting, development, study, starting a trial or obtaining a cooked label. Eating uses the existing eat implementation and actual remaining nutrition; mood never reduces basic nutrition. This capability introduces no new reward ledger writes. Observable inspection or an informative failed trial may produce an evidence-linked personal knowledge record, but a query or inconclusive repetition does not itself establish verified information gain. Any existing experience system may evaluate genuinely new verified evidence or personally applicable familiar participation only under its already implemented bounded amount, cap, decay/cooldown and functional-deduplication rules; if those rules are absent, this capability supplies no experience credit. Do not touch protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. Any actual warmth-related physical comfort must be computed from real exposure, remain capped at 10, and retain heat and burn hazards rather than becoming a mood bonus.
reviews.visualReview: Add reusable, capability-independent visual metadata for hearths, combustion processes and thermally treated food: component, state, source/process IDs, position, elapsed work, remaining fuel, visible ember/flame/smoke state, exposed food quantity and observed surface condition. Distinguish unprepared, prepared, friction-in-progress, failed/cooled, ember, burning, extinguished, food-heating, partly heated, cooked, charred and destroyed states. Emit observable events only for actual preparation, abrasion, ignition or failure, fuel consumption, food placement, turning, inspection findings, retrieval, burning and extinguishing. Flame requires an active combustion state; smoke requires actual emissions; cooked appearance requires the implemented exposure threshold. Do not show success on blocked or incomplete work. Inspection reports only perceivable or legitimately measured properties, preserves uncertainty about unmeasured core state and food improvements, and never exposes hidden resource locations or unobserved material attributes.
reviews.specification:
General capability: Thermal food preparation. Parameters: mode (prepare-hearth, ignite, tend, cook, inspect, retrieve, extinguish, cancel), owned input stack IDs, quantities, actual heat-source ID and site. Applicable actors may study it individually; it is not bound to Wren or meadow roots. Implement the smallest dry-roasting process, without requiring a pot, water, metal tools or a recipe tree. Do not grant any material, equipment, fire, skill or result when development completes. Development/review waiting advances no world time.
Dependencies and reuse: record reuse of gather for accessible loose fuel/material collection, pickup/drop for actual transfers, probe for ordinary observation or small physical sample trials, and eat for consumption. Preserve their existing costs and applicability; consult their complete implementation contracts in the handoff rather than guessing missing schemas. Add missing fire, heat-transfer and food-state mechanisms in this handoff. Resolve and test executable thermal and ignition rules before publication; do not repeatedly submit established rules to model review.
Exact applicant references: item-149-wren-1584 currently contains six owned roots from commons-root-5-1, harvested at tick 149, with decay 11.32003326 at the supplied snapshot. Revalidate current ownership, quantity, condition and reach before each action. The known raw-food baseline is nutrition 14 per root and toxicity zero. plot-42-wren-465 has visible stock zero and supplies no meal. start-1-stone is an observed rock source, not owned cooking equipment, a verified heat-safe stone or a fire starter. Nearby fallen branches require actual identification and collection; do not invent their IDs or reveal unseen resources.
Minimal ignition route: a hand-worked wood-friction trial using actually obtained dry tinder, kindling, fuel, a suitable soft deadwood hearth piece and a harder tapered rubbing piece. These are functional material requirements, not newly granted tools. Pieces must already have usable geometry or be demonstrably shapeable by implemented abrasion against an actually available surface; include that limited abrasion mechanism if necessary. If the available pieces cannot physically serve, report the observed obstacle and leave the trial blocked, without making nonexistent tools or pretending to start a fire. No sunlight concentration, sparks from arbitrary weathered stone, or spontaneous ignition. An alternative existing heat source may be supplied as an argument and must meet the same reach, access and safety checks.
Costs and work: study takes 3 rounds, with no material consumed and no mastery or experience reward. Hearth preparation takes 2 worked rounds at 1 energy each, on an accessible noncombustible patch with clearance from vegetation, people and possessions. It rearranges only real loose material and creates no stock. A friction attempt takes up to 12 worked rounds at 1.5 energy each, debiting only completed rounds; persistent progress records strokes, abrasion and heat. It is a genuine trial, not a guaranteed ignition timer. Its outcome must follow implemented material suitability, moisture, contact, effort, cooling and ignition thresholds. Ember transfer and initial tending each take 1 round at 0.5 energy and consume only tinder/kindling actually burned. Failed ignition leaves cooled or worn material, and any genuinely charred residue, not an active fire. Preparation and roasting setup take 1 round at 0.5 energy; inspect takes 1 round at 0.2 energy; turning, feeding, retrieving or extinguishing each takes 1 round at 0.5 energy, plus actual materials used. Passive heating is not paid actor labor, but advances only during actual world rounds. Gathering, travel and transfers cost their existing amounts in addition. No minimum fuel quantity is promised without checking its actual material and mass.
Conservation and thermal rules: fuel must be owned or otherwise legitimately available, physically transferred to the hearth, and reserved against double use. Burn only its remaining combustible mass, with an explicit energy yield per material, moisture penalty, burn rate and residue accounting in executable code. Account for heat delivered to food, hearth and surroundings and for evaporative loss; unused heat is lost or stored, not free inventory. Use the world's established time and mass units. The handoff must supply an explicit time conversion if thermal integration lacks one, without silently changing the rest of the simulation. Cooking duration is a computed number of elapsed rounds, not a guaranteed fixed finish time: report the estimate and required fuel after inspecting the actual setup, and update it from actual heat delivery. At minimum model food mass, exposed area, surface/core temperatures and cumulative exposure; a water-rich-food heat-capacity approximation of 4 kJ/kg/K may be declared as a model assumption, not a discovered species fact. No arbitrary actor-energy-to-fire conversion replaces ignition and combustion. Food contact must be physically supported on the actual hearth surface; no invisible rack or vessel. Safe handling requires a sufficiently cooled surface/item or an actual suitable handling implement, otherwise retrieval is blocked or incurs the modeled burn risk.
Products: reserve an explicitly selected quantity, initially at most one whole root per trial, leaving other roots untouched and ageing normally. Move that quantity into an identifiable cooking process; it cannot simultaneously be eaten, planted, given or cooked elsewhere. Produce a traceable edible, partially heated, charred or destroyed output according to real exposure, with source stack, quantity, age and treatment history preserved. Account for evaporated water, ash, gases, char and discarded matter so input cannot become multiple full portions. Conservatively retain nutrition at no more than the original 14 per root, reduced by any edible loss; do not grant extra nutrition for water loss or double-count raw and cooked versions. Existing spoilage continues and is never reset by cooking. Raw roots are already known edible with toxicity zero; heat does not imply detoxification, sterilization, longer shelf life or improved nutrition. Texture, warmth, browning and charring may change only through modeled exposure and observable inspection. A cooked-state label needs a declared exposure criterion; it is not proof of nutritional improvement or species-specific safety. Partial heating remains partial, and badly burnt material is not presented as a successful meal.
Persistence and safety: each job stores actor, input references, reserved quantities, work completed, material wear, fuel balance, elapsed exposure, temperatures and output state. Preflight checks reject invalid references without material or energy charges. Leaving reach, exhaustion or interruption pauses manual work and charges no unperformed rounds. Resume rechecks ownership, reach, materials and safety; stored heat cools while actual time passes. A lit fire continues consuming its real fuel, emitting heat/smoke and potentially heating or burning unattended food until extinguished or exhausted. Include burns and ignition of actually exposed combustible material under bounded executable hazard rules; block unsafe initial placement rather than treating a campsite as magically fireproof. Tending consumes effort and only the fuel actually added. Hearth condition, fuel level and food exposure require maintenance; no permanent heat source is created. Cancel releases only unconsumed reserved material, once, at its real location; already spent effort, burned fuel, spoiled food and transformed matter are not refunded. Extinguishing must use actual removal/smothering or a physically available extinguishing medium and track its cost. Death ends personal work and releases or drops unconsumed carried inputs according to existing death rules; fire, residues and food remain physically present and continue their processes. No automatic extinguishing, duplicated refunds or transfer of the deceased's learning. Other people act only through their own independent actions and permissions; no assumed assistance or consent.

reviews.reason: Develop a general food examination and simple mechanical handling operation. The reviewed related capabilities do not cover the whole requested function: probe (open-baseline:probe:1, open.probe) supports observation and small destructive press/wet/heat trials, not controlled opening of a whole food unit; plant-cultivation inspects planting suitability; hearth-food-preparation handles heat preparation and currently accepts roots or berries; consult reads existing records but supplies no new food-use knowledge. Reuse their applicable observation, record-reading and item-state code rather than claiming those mechanisms as new. Search results were incomplete and the query budget is exhausted; the development handoff must check remaining registry contracts for an equivalent mechanical handling operation before adding duplicate code. Missing shell mechanics are a development dependency, not grounds for rejection. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Sol studies individually for one round after implementation; approval is not mastery. Inspection, requests, registration, study and action invocation award no automatic wellbeing. This initial capability makes no direct pleasure, satisfaction, comfort, nutrition or reward-account changes. A genuinely new, evidence-backed observation or informative failed trial may be submitted to an already implemented experience rule only if it verifies personal information gain; unknown or inconclusive results alone do not qualify. Any such existing rule must enforce its bounded amount, per-fact functional deduplication, cooldown and decay rather than reward repeated inspection or renamed records. Familiar legitimate handling may receive only an existing modest practice benefit under its real-event conditions, never a new unconditional bonus. Basic nutrition remains governed by actual consumption and is not reduced by mood; no protected accounts, budgets, goals or permissions change.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable examine-start/completed, handling-start, blocked, trial-failed, material-damaged, shell-opened, paused, resumed and cancelled events only when their corresponding events actually occur. Reuse visual metadata with operation/mode, actor, target and product IDs, position, progress, actual shell state, visible fragments, tool contact and evidence/uncertainty fields. An examination can show an observation indicator but not an edible/safe badge. Failed or unfinished opening retains the actual closed or damaged appearance and cannot display a revealed kernel or success animation. Show an exposed interior only after the conserved separation transaction commits; no invented products, glow or wellbeing effects.
reviews.specification:
Implement Examine and mechanically handle food as one general operation parameterized by owned inputStackId, quantity (initial executable limit: one whole unit), mode (examine or open), and optional toolIds/supportTargetId. No interface is bound to Sol or to hazelnuts. Exact initial target: item-159-sol-1678, resource hazelnut, quantity 1, origin start-1-nuts, harvestedAt 159. Revalidate current ownership, quantity, reach, condition and actual shell state at execution; the supplied decay 4.38010993 is historical, not a diagnosis of visible spoilage. Do not touch reserve root stack item-155-sol-1631.
Examine costs one active round and 0.2 energy, with no material consumption. It reports only externally perceivable shape, surface, visible damage, exposed interior and observable spoilage signs, explicitly marking unobserved properties unknown. Any statements of established personal food-use knowledge must cite an actual accessible personal record and its evidence, not resource labels, hidden nutritional/toxin fields or the developer's general knowledge. Sol has no supplied evidence establishing raw safety. Retain uncertainty even if no spoilage is visible. Opening is not tasting, cooking, detoxification or consumption.
Open attempts one mechanically supported separation per active round at 0.5 energy. First executable scope is manual peeling, splitting or shell opening where actual grip and force suffice, or cracking with an explicitly selected reachable suitable owned implement and stable accessible support. No stone, tool, bench or food is supplied. start-1-stone is an observed natural source, not an owned hammer; gathering or reaching it remains a separate paid action. Validate force, contact geometry, support stability, material resistance and tool wear through existing physical/material code. If those mechanisms are missing, add the minimal resistance-and-force test and separation transaction in the current development handoff; never let the language model decide success repeatedly at runtime. Do not infer that fingers can crack this hazelnut. With inadequate prerequisites, report a blocked attempt without energy or world-time charge; an actually performed unsuccessful trial pays its round and energy and records any real damage. A damaged but unopened shell is not an opened product.
Reuse existing item identity, ownership, age, treatment, spoilage and observation machinery, recording reused handlers/modules and revisions in the implementation manifest. Where composition is not represented, introduce a conserved composition ledger before separating products: shell, interior, fragments and losses must partition the original material and original food/nutrition entitlement, never create extra whole edible units or reset age. Do not invent numerical shell mass from the supplied resource label. Outputs retain parent/origin references and current condition; debris and discarded material remain at the work location. A physically exposed interior is described as exposed, not certified edible. Any later eating uses eat and actual applicable nutrition/toxicity rules.
Each completed round commits observations, damage, wear, energy and material transfers atomically. Persist target, selected method, completed separations and accumulated damage as progress; unworked rounds pause without productive progress. Resume revalidates ownership, reach, tools, energy and current material state. Cancel releases reservations and stops further work; death does likewise and leaves actual items/products under the existing death-placement rules. Neither restores damage, consumed effort or discarded material; no duplicate refund or new inventory. No automatic continuing process, maintenance bonus or accelerated preservation is introduced; ordinary ageing continues during elapsed world rounds.
